question: Will Adam Abdelilah Huram (Hajduk Split) assist vs HNK Gorica on Oct 31, 2026 (regular time + stoppage only)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes, at least one assist": Wins if Adam Abdelilah Huram is credited with at least one assist for Hajduk Split in the HNL match against HNK Gorica, scored strictly after 2026-10-31T14:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-31T22:00:00Z, counting only goals scored during regular time and stoppage time (i.e., excluding extra time and penalty shootout).
- "No assist": Wins if Adam Abdelilah Huram is credited with zero assists for Hajduk Split in the same match under the same conditions, or if he does not appear in the match at all.

Clarifications:
- An assist is defined as the final pass or touch directly leading to a goal, as recorded in the official match statistics. Only assists on goals that count during regulation (90 minutes plus any added stoppage time at the end of each half) are included; goals in extra time or a penalty shootout do not count.
